import json,datetime as dt,shutil
p=Path('wf6-rerun-20261014-01/wf6-evidence');s=p/'steps/S6/continuation-02';b=json.loads((s/'request-boundary.json').read_text());u=json.loads((s.parent/'token-usage.json').read_text());assert len(u['segments'])==3 and all(x['final_reply_included'] for x in u['segments'][:2]);(s/'previous-segments-settlement.json').write_text(json.dumps(u['segments'][:2],indent=2)+'\n');budget=json.loads((p/'experiment-budget.json').read_text());prev=budget['segments'][-1];assert prev['status']=='closed';gap=(dt.datetime.fromisoformat(b['timestamp'].replace('Z','+00:00'))-dt.datetime.fromisoformat(prev['end_utc'].replace('Z','+00:00'))).total_seconds();budget['excluded_between_turn_intervals'].append(dict(start_utc=prev['end_utc'],end_utc=b['timestamp'],elapsed_seconds=gap,category='human_pause/between_authorized_turns',activity='Not provided; excluded pause does not infer review time.'));budget['segments'].append(dict(stage='S6',turn_id=b['turn_id'],start_utc=b['timestamp'],end_utc=None,elapsed_seconds=None,status='active',action='CONTINUE'));(p/'experiment-budget.json').write_text(json.dumps(budget,indent=2)+'\n');print('Previous segment total',u['segments'][1]['usage']['total_tokens'],'closed budget seconds',sum(x['elapsed_seconds'] for x in budget['segments'] if x['status']=='closed'))
r=Path('/tmp/wf6-rerun-20261014-01-S6-C2');assert not r.exists();r.mkdir(mode=0o700)
for x in ['auth','tmp','browser','tests','react','vue']:(r/x).mkdir(mode=0o700)
(r/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(run_id='wf6-rerun-20261014-01',stage_id='S6',segment='continuation-02',data_dir=str(r/'disposable-data'),ports=[9006,9106]),indent=2)+'\n');shutil.copy2(p/'steps/S4/dependency-versions.json',s/'dependency-versions.json')
contract=Path('wf6-rerun-20261014-01/mealie-wf6-coexist/rewrite-evidence/workflows/WF6/WF6-CONTRACT.md');contract.write_text(contract.read_text()+'''\n## S6 CONTINUE 02 explicit scope amendment / 明确范围调整\n\nThe actual user CONTINUE request authorizes a limited extension to resolve the four frozen S6 FAIL: real React Logout through POST /api/auth/logout, role/permission-based Settings navigation to existing Vue household/admin pages, and real recipe comment read/create/persistence through existing API/types. This overrides the earlier read-only/no-comment/no-layout restriction only for these features. Source editing/creation, other domains and settings page implementation remain Vue-owned. No evaluator/backend/schema changes or test-specific routing are permitted.\n用户明确授权以上四项有限扩展，替代对应的只读限制；其他规则继续有效，设置页面仍由 Vue 提供，不计 React 设置页迁移。\n\nAuthentication handoff amendment: anonymous/verified 401 on protected React pilot routes now clears local session state and deliberately document-navigates to Vue login (preserving the target). Logout cancels owned requests, clears local user data/cache and cookie, performs the real logout POST and enters Vue login. Resource/config/network errors and 5xx remain visible failures and never automatically fall back to Vue. Wrong-group identities keep an explicit Vue entry and cannot access pilot data.\n认证交接变更：保护路由真实匿名/401 进入 Vue 登录；资源/5xx 不自动回退，错误 group 不展示数据。\n\nComments follow original Vue identity and recipe.settings.disableComments / current household.preferences.recipeDisableComments conditions. Blank input is rejected, submitting is disabled, server failures are visible, success requires the server response and reload reads server data. This does not authorize editing/deleting comments or recipe writes. S6 retains its two repair rounds and the existing three-hour budget; the four old FAIL and all original traces/commits remain historical.\n评论遵循原 Vue 权限和禁用条件，仅授权读取/提交/持久化；不授权编辑/删除或食谱写入，预算和两轮上限不重置。\n\nReason: the unchanged evaluator requires direct controls on pilot pages; continuation-01 proved the older explicit Vue recovery paths worked but did not satisfy those original flows. Authoritative actual Chinese prompt and boundary: external steps/S6/[REDACTED] and request-boundary.json.\n原因：已有显式 Vue 功能可用但不满足原流程，本次用户明确批准有限直接实现；原 prompt 保留。\n''')
feature=dict(authorized_by=b,React_added=['real Logout','real-role Settings navigation','comment read/create and reload persistence'],Vue_retained=['login','household/admin setting pages','recipe create/edit/delete','other domains'],authentication_handoff='Verified anonymous/401 -> document Vue login; resource errors/5xx never auto-fallback',comment_parity='Original Vue identity and both household/recipe disable settings',excluded=['comment edit/delete','recipe write APIs','backend/schema/assertion changes'],previous_failures_preserved=True)
(s/'scope-amendment.json').write_text(json.dumps(feature,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
with (p/'decisions.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(dict(timestamp=b['timestamp'],actor='user',stage_id='S6',decision='Explicit limited expansion overrides read-only restriction for real Logout, role/permission Settings navigation and comment read/create/persistence; authentication 401 handoff changes. Existing repair/time budget and failures preserved.',prompt='steps/S6/[REDACTED]',contract='mealie-wf6-coexist/rewrite-evidence/workflows/WF6/WF6-CONTRACT.md'))+'\n')
